sharedNames.$comment: The rule names eslint-plugin-sonarjs shares with ESLint core or typescript-eslint, derived from the packages' own metadata: each plugin rule folder's eslintId and sonarKey, against ESLint's built-in rules and typescript-eslint's plugin rules. The engine matches a marker by its rule name's last segment, so a marker naming the shared rule may also silence the Sonar rule (DESIGN-sonar-configuration-management.md F-5, D-5).
